extension.description: TM1 / IBM Planning Analytics in VS Code: TurboIntegrator debugger, linter and autocomplete, rule editor, cube viewer with write-back, dimension editor, MDX runner and Git mirror.
viewsWelcome.tm1Explorer.contents:
No TM1 server configured yet.
Add a connection to an IBM Planning Analytics (TM1) server to browse its cubes, dimensions and processes.
[Add Server](command:tm1.addServer)
config.tm1.timeoutMs.description: HTTP inactivity timeout in milliseconds for general API requests. 0 = no timeout (default) — a busy server may compute a response for a long time without sending data; a timeout would abort it. Set > 0 to cap idle time.
config.tm1.connectTimeoutMs.description: Time in milliseconds to wait for the server while connecting and testing a connection (default 20000). A Basic or CAM login travels with this first request, so raise it for a slow CAM namespace or VPN link.
config.tm1.debugPollTimeoutMs.descriptio: Maximum wait time (ms) while debugging until the next breakpoint (default: 30000)
config.tm1.references.debugLog.descripti: Verbose logging of the reference-index build phases (Processes/Chores fetch, fallbacks, index stats) to the 'TM1 References' output channel. Warnings/errors are always logged.
config.tm1.cubeStats.debugLog.descriptio: Verbose logging of cube structures (dimension lists, element samples) and the generated MDX queries for the RAM dashboard to the 'TM1 RAM-Dashboard' output channel. HTTP/parse errors are always logged.
config.tm1.password.description: Deprecated. Legacy plaintext password. No longer used — configure servers via the TM1 Explorer (passwords are stored in the OS secret storage).
config.tm1.password.deprecation: `tm1.password` is deprecated and no longer used — its plaintext value is ignored (it would leak into git if committed in settings.json). Add servers via the TM1 Explorer instead; passwords are stored in the OS secret storage.
config.tm1.maxSockets.description: Maximum number of requests running at the same time per TM1 server (default: 4). TM1 binds one worker thread to each connection, so this is also the upper bound for the threads this extension occupies on the server. Lower it (1–2) if a CAM environment is sensitive to thread count.
config.tm1.threadRefreshMs.description: Refresh interval (ms) for the thread monitor panel (default: 2000)
config.tm1.threadRefreshTimeoutMs.descri: HTTP timeout (ms) for thread monitor requests (default: 5000)
config.tm1.messageLogRefreshMs.descripti: Refresh interval (ms) for the message log panel (default: 5000)
config.tm1.objectExplorerAutoRefreshMs.d: Auto-refresh interval (ms) for the Object Explorer. 0 = disabled.
config.tm1.diagnostics.logActivationTimi: Logs a cold-start breakdown of extension activation (phase × ms) to the TM1 output channel. Useful for performance audits.
config.tm1.v12Mode.description: V12 compatibility mode: flags TI functions that are no longer available in TM1 / Planning Analytics v12 (Cloud Native).
config.tm1.lint.nameWhitespaceInsensitiv: Compare TM1 object/element names case- AND whitespace-insensitively when linting (TM1 stores 'Hallo Welt' as 'hallowelt'). Affects Subset/View cleanup pairing and the server existence check. Disable if a setup treats whitespace as significant.
config.tm1.tests.rootFolder.description: Workspace-relative root folder for the TI test framework (record-and-replay). The folder structure below it is free-form.
config.tm1.tests.floatTolerance.descript: Float comparison tolerance for the cell diff (default 1e-9).
config.tm1.tests.maxDiffRows.description: Rows kept per kind (different value, missing, extra, equal) in the TI test diff. The rest is only counted. Higher values cost memory: 2 million kept rows held about 1.4 GB.
config.tm1.tests.keepCloneOnError.descri: If the capture helper process (<process>_TI) fails, leave it on the server instead of deleting it — inspectable for debugging in the TM1 Explorer.
debug.processName.description: Name of the TI process (file name without extension)
debug.serverId.description: Id of the connected TM1 server profile to debug against. Omit only when a single server is connected — with several connected profiles the launch is refused instead of guessing.

config.tm1.nativeApiPath.description: TM1 bin64 directory containing tm1api.dll and the ssl keystore files. Leave empty to search the standard IBM installation directories. The native API is part of your IBM TM1 installation and is not shipped with this extension. TM1 Top requires Windows x64 and .NET Framework 4.x. Only the legacy TM1 Top thread monitor needs it; every other feature works over REST.

config.tm1.cubeViewer.copyDecimalSeparat: Cube Viewer: decimal separator used when copying selected cells (Ctrl/Cmd+C) so Excel parses the raw values as numbers. 'auto' follows the OS locale, which Excel also uses — so a German Excel gets a comma even when VS Code runs in English.
Detect from the operating-system locale (matches how Excel parses numbers)
Always use a point (e.g. 1234.56) — for an English-locale Excel
Always use a comma (e.g. 1234,56) — for a German-locale Excel
